summary: Fuel station management application with inventory tracking, sales & billing, staff management, cash tracking, analytics, and operational tools
architectural_notes: Multi-module architecture: Inventory, Sales, Staff, Finance, Analytics, Operations
Real-time monitoring capabilities required for tank levels and sales
Integration points: SMS/WhatsApp APIs, POS systems, GST/accounting software, payment gateways
Role-based access: Owner, manager, staff levels with appropriate permissions
Mobile-first design for owner monitoring app
known_issues: Staff Management: 'Add New Staff Member' displays 'failed to add staff member' error
Staff Management: Commission rate (%) field was unintentionally removed from the staff form

existing_features.title: Implement tank level monitoring system that tracks fuel levels for multiple tanks (Petrol, Diesel) with current volume, capacity, and percentage filled
Create automatic alert system that triggers notifications when tank levels fall below configurable thresholds for refill
Build daily stock reconciliation feature that compares opening stock, purchases, sales, and closing stock with variance reporting
Implement sales and billing system with invoice generation, fuel type selection, quantity, rate, and total calculation
Build staff management module with staff profiles, login credentials, and role assignment (Manager, Operator, Attendant)
Implement shift management system with shift start/end times, staff assignment, and attendance tracking
Create shift-wise sales reporting that aggregates all sales, cash collection, and expenses per shift with staff details
Build commission and incentive calculation system based on sales volume or value with configurable rates per staff member
Implement daily cash collection entry system recording cash received from sales with denomination breakdown and total reconciliation
Create expense logging system with categories (maintenance, electricity, salaries, supplies) including amount, date, and description
Build profit and loss dashboard calculating total revenue, total expenses, and net profit/loss with visual indicators
Implement sales reporting with daily, weekly, and monthly views showing total sales, fuel type breakdown, and transaction counts
Create fuel type performance analytics comparing Petrol vs Diesel sales volume, revenue, and trends over time
Create visual analytics with line and bar charts showing sales trends, fuel type distribution, and forecasting patterns
Implement price update module allowing fuel price changes with effective date and automatic application to new sales

Design a modern, professional dashboard interface with a clean layout using a neutral color palette (grey, white, black accents) and clear typography suitable for a business management application. Include cards for key metrics, intuitive navigation, and data-dense tables and charts that emphasize readability and quick data access.
Update the ProfileSetup component to include 'Owner' in the role selection dropdown, maintaining the existing UI pattern for role selection
Update the StaffManagement component to include 'Owner' in the role selection dropdown when adding or editing staff members
Fix the 'Add New Staff Member' functionality in the StaffManagement component to successfully add staff members instead of displaying 'failed to add staff member' error
Restore the 'commission rate (%)' field to the staff member form in the StaffManagement component
Update the StaffManagement component to enable the 'Add New Staff Member' button for users with Admin (Owner) role in addition to the existing Manager role access
